rubric.name: Sounds like a person talking
rubric.question: Each line: natural / a bit off / clearly off. Written-style, lecture tone, translated-from-Chinese phrasing, telegraphic lists all count as off

rubric.name: Flow and transitions
rubric.question: Cold open, the 'what's coming' part, chapter changes, before/after examples: does it sound like one person following a thought, not 'Point one…' templates or a TOC read aloud? Do adjacent lines connect?

rubric.name: Clear on one hearing
rubric.question: Ear only: one new idea per line; clear reference ('this' points to something); terms explained before used; numbers and words not misheard

rubric.name: Tight
rubric.question: No filler, repetition, or empty truisms; point out lines that could go without losing anything

rubric.name: Voice and rhythm
rubric.question: One warm, clear, unpretentious narrator throughout; varied sentence length; each line sayable in one breath
